title: Being one of the few old musicians left
summary: Ridgley says leaving the saxophone was best and he is content.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: I made a pretty good... I got along pretty good by being in the saxophone. I think I made the best move. You see? I've made all those old fellas who are gone.
Fred, you're one of the few that's left of your age. The only one trouble I'm blessed was my time ago. And all of them. All of them were gone. I think I'm an only one there.
Henry, Sonny Henry. Yeah, he was a bad move. But he was always pretty strong. And I think sometime, I say, well, maybe add a little something to my life.
Right. Anyway, if you're happy, that's the way to be. Happy. Very happy. You look happy.
